More than notifications

A personal AI layer on free infrastructure: natural language, recurring memory, and delivery when something matters.

Talk or type

Chat in plain English. Mic button for speech-to-text while the app is open.

Smart reminders

Every N days, snooze, and “done” — the cycle restarts from the day you choose.

Weather & news

Places and keywords you pick. Not a generic city-wide blast.

Private account

Email verification. Your watches and reminders stay with you.

Start in a few minutes

  1. Install on a device or open the assistant in the browser.
  2. Create an account and verify the email code.
  3. Enable notifications under Delivery.
  4. In Chat, say what to watch or remind — confirm when asked.

Install on iPhone or iPad

  1. Open Safari.
  2. Go to the Notify assistant.
  3. Tap Share → Add to Home Screen.
  4. Open from the icon → enable notifications when asked.
Open assistant

Install on Windows

  1. Open Notify in Chrome or Edge.
  2. Menu → Install app.
  3. Launch from Start like any other program.
